story_title: Submit a claim with an itemised receipt
acceptance_criteria: AC1: A member can submit a claim through the member portal with an itemised receipt attached. | AC2: An itemised receipt shows the treatment, the treatment date and the amount. notes: Negative because it is missing information

story_title: Track annual limits per policy year
acceptance_criteria: AC1: The first policy year starts on the date cover began; each later policy year starts on the anniversary of that date. Each runs for 12 months. | AC2: Annual limits: GP visit 8 visits, consultant visit 4 visits, physiotherapy 10 sessions, prescription 12 items, day case procedure 2 procedures. Inpatient stays have no fixed annual count; they are assessed individually. | AC3: When the number already paid in a category this policy year equals the annual limit, a further claim in that category is routed to decline_recommended with reason code ANNUAL_LIMIT_REACHED. | AC4: When the number already paid is below the annual limit, the annual limit does not stop the claim.
case_title: GP visits one above the annual limit
preconditions: The current policy year is known. | 9 GP visits have already been paid in the current policy year.
steps: Submit a further GP visit claim.
expected_result: The configured annual limit is 8 GP visits. The acceptance criteria specify no routing outcome when the number already paid is above the limit, so no specific disposition is asserted.
notes: The expected result indicates that acceptance criteria doesn't contain any routing detail yet this is mentioned in AC3

story_title: Apply the waiting period and its exemptions
acceptance_criteria: AC1: The day number is the treatment date minus the policy start date, so the start date is day 0. Treatment before day 182 is in the waiting period. Treatment on day 182 or later is not. | AC2: Treatment in the waiting period that is not a GP visit and is clearly not for an accidental injury is routed to decline_recommended with reason code WAITING_PERIOD. | AC3: GP visits are covered from day 0. | AC4: Treatment for an accidental injury is exempt from the waiting period when the provider's treatment description shows the injury was accidental. The exemption removes the waiting period only; the receipt, referral, pre-authorisation and amount limits still apply. | AC5: If a claim in the waiting period may be for an accidental injury but the provider's description does not show it (including when only the claimant's note says so), it is routed to manual_review with reason code UNCLEAR.
case_title: Clearly non-accidental non-GP treatment before the policy start date
preconditions: The policy start date is 2023-01-01. | The claim is for a non-GP visit. | The provider's description clearly shows the treatment is not for an accidental injury.
steps: Submit the claim with a treatment date of 2022-12-31.
expected_result: The treatment date is day -1 by the stated date-difference calculation, which is before day 182. The claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code WAITING_PERIOD.
notes: Valid test. Check around waiting period and non-accidental, non GP claim

acceptance_criteria: AC1: A claim must be submitted within 12 months of the treatment date. The last day to submit is the same calendar date one year after the treatment date. For example, for treatment on 10 March 2027, a claim submitted on 10 March 2028 is on time and one submitted on 11 March 2028 is late. | AC2: For treatment on 29 February, the last day to submit is 28 February of the following year. | AC3: The deadline is checked against the claim's submission date. | AC4: A claim submitted after the last day is routed to decline_recommended with reason code LATE_SUBMISSION.

preconditions: Treatment date is 10 March 2027. | The claim submission date is 11 March 2028.
steps: Evaluate the claim's submission date against its deadline.
expected_result: The deadline is 10 March 2028. The claim is late and is routed to decline_recommended with reason code LATE_SUBMISSION.
notes: Valid test. Date processing around leap-year logic. One caveat is that it is using dates provided within the AC
